name: Sautéed Swiss Chard Leaves (Stems Removed, Cooked Tender)
whyItWorks: Earthy Swiss chard with rigid center stalks completely stripped out, leaving only tender leafy greens gently simmered in olive oil and broth until soft.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fold chard leaves in half and rip away the thick fibrous central rib. Cook leaves in 1 tsp olive oil and 2 tbsp broth in a covered skillet for 6 minutes until collapsed.
